visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a close-up of a traditional Japanese irori hearth inside a restaurant. Several skewers of sliced zucchini and fish are leaning against the embers. Sparks fly from the charcoal as the camera pans slightly. The background shows stainless steel kitchen equipment and shelves. (2) A person wearing black gloves uses tongs to flip chicken skewers on a wire grill over glowing coals. To the side, several round rice balls are also being toasted. (3) A whole peeled red tomato sits in a blue ceramic bowl, topped with seaweed and garnishes. A pair of chopsticks lifts a slice, revealing the juicy interior. (4) A hand presents a plate with three square crackers, each topped with a mound of green avocado mash and chopped raw tuna. (5) A single skewer of grilled chicken skin/meat is shown being held over a plate containing a small pile of green wasabi and red spice powder. (6) A bowl of sliced grilled pork is displayed, garnished with green onions and a slice of lime. A chopstick picks up a piece of meat. (7) A crab shell is placed on a small tabletop grill; inside, it is filled with crab meat, roe, and topped with green onions. A wooden spoon scoops out the hot mixture. (8) A large, golden-brown deep-fried croquette is broken open by a wooden spoon, revealing a creamy interior mixed with crab meat and roe. (9) A piece of grilled fish is presented on a blue plate; chopsticks flake off a tender white piece of meat. (10) A plate of sliced, grilled zucchini rounds is shown, seasoned with sesame seeds. (11) A large, round miso-glazed rice ball is shown being wrapped in a crisp sheet of dark green nori. (12) A sizzling iron plate holds stir-fried beef strips and bean sprouts. A pair of tongs lifts a generous portion of the steaming vegetables and meat. (13) A small colorful ceramic cup of chawanmushi (steamed egg) is opened, showing corn kernels and herbs on top. A wooden spoon takes a scoop of the silky yellow custard. (14) Clear broth is poured from a traditional reddish-brown clay teapot into a small matching cup on a wooden tray. (15) The camera pans across the interior of the restaurant, showing male and female customers sitting at a long wooden bar counter and tables, with menu boards on the wall. (16) The final shot shows the traditional wooden exterior entrance of the restaurant at night with a purple Noren curtain.
